summary_1line: After rescuing Draupadi from Jayadratha, Yudhishthira laments their misfortune and asks the sage Markandeya if anyone has suffered more than he.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits in the forest beside sage Markandeya, surrounded by grieving ascetics as Draupadi stands nearby after her rescue.
The Pandavas rest in the shadowy Kamyaka forest, their weapons laid aside while Yudhishthira speaks sorrowfully before the gathered sages.
